additional_info.body:
Dear Mrs. Hamerslag,
I hope you are doing well.
Thank you raising the issue.
After remote troubleshooting, there is no active error log remain from our side. Can you please also check from your side.
The charger now has full potentiality to charge. Even currently it´s in used condition.
It is also recommended that, the the charger should updated to latest firmware version to avoid those type of bug issues in future. If you are unable to do it. Please let us know in a separate ticket. We will remotely perform that update.
If everything is okay, a quick feedback will be very helpful to close the ticket.
I wish you a happy holiday season to you and your family.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
